_label: PHASE 3 BATCH 3A — nakshatra application claims for Ashwini through Ardra; universal, development only, practitioner review required
scope: Nakshatras 1–6: Ashwini, Bharani, Krittika, Rohini, Mrigashira and Ardra.
writerRule: Only applicationClaims may reach the customer-writing model. Deities, symbols, mythology, source history, technical rulerships and excluded classical judgments remain internal trace.

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Ashwini is the Moon's nakshatra, one of the smaller lunar sections used to refine how the Moon's emotional qualities are expressed.
The mind may mobilize quickly when a situation calls for a practical response, correction or fresh start.
Skill and intelligence may become most apparent when you can respond actively rather than remain passive.
The wish to move quickly may sometimes need to be balanced with enough reflection to understand what the situation genuinely requires.

compositionRequirements: APP-ASHWINI-QUICK-MOBILIZATION requires at least one additional non-nakshatra chart factor in the reading.
APP-ASHWINI-NAKSHATRA-CONTEXT must appear before every other Ashwini interpretation.
prohibitedExtensions: presenting modern synthesis as classical quotation

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Bharani is the Moon's nakshatra, one of the smaller lunar sections used to refine how the Moon's emotional qualities are expressed.
You may approach emotionally important matters with firm resolve and the capacity to endure pressure over time.
Responsibility may carry emotional weight, particularly when you have committed to carrying something through to completion.
Truthfulness and practical dexterity may help you manage demanding situations without losing sight of what matters.
Endurance may become burdensome when you continues carrying a responsibility after its useful purpose has ended.

compositionRequirements: APP-BHARANI-RESPONSIBLE-COMPLETION requires at least one additional non-nakshatra chart factor in the reading.
APP-BHARANI-NAKSHATRA-CONTEXT must appear before every other Bharani interpretation.
prohibitedExtensions: presenting modern synthesis as classical quotation

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Krittika is the Moon's nakshatra, one of the smaller lunar sections used to refine how the Moon's emotional qualities are expressed.
The emotional temperament may carry strong energy and spirited intensity.
The mind may seek clarity by separating what is essential from what no longer belongs in the situation.
Clear discernment may become overly sharp when urgency leaves too little room for nuance or another person's perspective.
Development may involve using intensity to clarify and refine rather than simply reject or cut away.

compositionRequirements: APP-KRITTIKA-CLARIFYING-DISCERNMENT requires at least one additional non-nakshatra chart factor in the reading.
APP-KRITTIKA-SPIRITED-INTENSITY must appear with a constructive admitted claim.
APP-KRITTIKA-NAKSHATRA-CONTEXT must appear before every other Krittika interpretation.
prohibitedExtensions: presenting modern synthesis as classical quotation

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Rohini is the Moon's nakshatra, one of the smaller lunar sections used to refine how the Moon's emotional qualities are expressed.
You may bring steadiness of mind to what they value and wish to develop.
Sincere and persuasive communication may help you give tangible form to an idea or intention.
Emotional energy may be drawn toward growth: making an idea, relationship or resource more stable and tangible over time.
Development may involve nurturing what genuinely matters without measuring its value only against what someone else possesses or achieves.

compositionRequirements: APP-ROHINI-GROWTH-INTO-FORM requires at least one additional non-nakshatra chart factor in the reading.
APP-ROHINI-NAKSHATRA-CONTEXT must appear before every other Rohini interpretation.
prohibitedExtensions: presenting modern synthesis as classical quotation

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Mrigashira is the Moon's nakshatra, one of the smaller lunar sections used to refine how the Moon's emotional qualities are expressed.
Curiosity may lead the mind to keep searching until it understands what will feel genuinely satisfying or meaningful.
Ingenuity and skill may help you follow a question beyond its first or most obvious answer.
Hopefulness and energy may return when you have something worthwhile to explore or pursue.
The wish to keep searching may sometimes make it difficult to recognize when enough understanding has already been found.

compositionRequirements: APP-MRIGASHIRA-SEARCHING-CURIOSITY requires at least one additional non-nakshatra chart factor in the reading.
APP-MRIGASHIRA-NAKSHATRA-CONTEXT must appear before every other Mrigashira interpretation.
prohibitedExtensions: presenting modern synthesis as classical quotation

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Ardra is the Moon's nakshatra, one of the smaller lunar sections used to refine how the Moon's emotional qualities are expressed.
Emotionally disruptive periods may be experienced with intensity rather than easily set aside.
You may develop strength through the effort of facing difficult material and working through what cannot simply be ignored.
Development may involve giving emotional intensity a constructive direction without treating turmoil as necessary for growth.

compositionRequirements: APP-ARDRA-DISRUPTION-INTENSITY requires at least one additional non-nakshatra chart factor in the reading.
APP-ARDRA-EFFORT-THROUGH-DIFFICULTY requires at least one additional non-nakshatra chart factor in the reading.
APP-ARDRA-INTENSITY-DIRECTION requires at least one additional non-nakshatra chart factor in the reading.
APP-ARDRA-DISRUPTION-INTENSITY must appear with APP-ARDRA-EFFORT-THROUGH-DIFFICULTY or APP-ARDRA-INTENSITY-DIRECTION.
APP-ARDRA-NAKSHATRA-CONTEXT must appear before every other Ardra interpretation.

implementationRequirements: Merge this overlay additively without modifying earlier application-claim overlays.
Route every claim exclusively from its purposes field; no nakshatra name or claim ID may be hard-coded into planner or writer logic.
Use the universal nakshatra introduction pattern, name the nakshatra once only and introduce the pada without repeating the nakshatra name.
Never send customerExcludedLayers, source history or technical rulerships to the writer.
Enforce every composition requirement and prohibited extension.
Log unused admitted claims as ADMITTED_NOT_USED without warning or failure.
Production must admit zero claims from this file until individual practitioner approval changes productionEligible.
For conflict-restricted records, preserve the restriction in ledger and trace and do not promote synthesized meanings as classical doctrine.
